title: Chapter 311: First Construction Of The Heavenly Court
content:
Chapter 311: First Construction Of The Heavenly Court

As for the later Xuanyuan Chiyou, their remnants are rarely seen, that is, Xuanyuan's Huangshi Tianshu, Chiyou's soldier demon god and the sword, which can still prove their existence.

The Huangshi Tianshu is nothing special, it is just a divination method used in this world, and it is of no great use outside this world. There are also some secret techniques in it, which are enough for people to cultivate to the fifth level. For people in this world, they already belong to the category of magic tricks.

But to Zhong Yu, although it is precious, it is nothing.

It was Chi You's retention that made Zhong Yu reap a lot, and he was a little excited.

Not to mention the Soldier Demon God, after being acquired by Zhong Yu, he was sacrificed many times with the method of blood refining. In the end, he completely controlled it, erased Chi You's mark, and became a war machine that could finally be absolutely controlled.

And the remaining magic sword was also integrated into the blood sword forged by Zhong Yu with the method of blood refining, making the blood sword even more powerful.

This demonic sword is worthy of being left by the demon god Chi You, and it is extremely powerful.

Once refined into the blood sword, the quality of the blood sword soared from the original low-grade magic weapon to a middle-grade magic weapon. The power of the blood sword has greatly increased, two or three times better than before.

At the same time, the characteristics possessed by the blood sword have also added a kind of demonic energy from the original two kinds of murderous aura and evil spirit, giving the blood sword an additional bewitching ability.

And it is extremely corrosive. Anyone who is injured by the blood sword will be invaded by the devil energy, making it extremely difficult to escape.

And this blood sword did not stop refining after Zhong Yu withdrew from the Central Plains.

Instead, let Zhong Yu send his confidant, carrying the blood sword and other blood swords of the same nature, to frequent all over the battlefield, where there are dead people, these blood swords appear.

Naturally, other countries have also noticed these people. However, they only thought that Yu Guo sent them to inquire about the news, so they didn't care much about it.

So this allowed Zhong Yu's plot to succeed.

After the death of tens of millions of people across the Central Plains, using their souls and blood to sacrifice, all 365 divine weapons have been promoted to the top-grade spiritual weapons.

And the remaining 100,000 ordinary blood soldiers also devoured and fused each other. After being supported by those bloody souls, they finally got 10,000 high-grade magic weapons.

After distributing these magical weapons and spiritual weapons, the power of Dun Zhongyu's subordinates increased greatly, which skyrocketed several times.

At the same time, after more than ten years of training, coupled with Zhong Yu's continuous supply of luck, Zhong Yu finally has an army of 5,000 fourth-tier powerhouses under his command.

These legions are all equipped with high-grade magic weapons and blood soldiers provided by Zhong Yu, and their overall strength is not weak, almost equivalent to the strength of the little Gao Xuenv and others in the original book.

And the fourth-tier masters, in the world of comprehension, are already the lowest-level qi training disciples. It can also be regarded as stepping into the path of transcendence and pursuit of eternity.

Similarly, the 365 divine weapons with high-quality spiritual weapons also found their owners one after another.

The masters of these magical weapons are all at the fifth level of cultivation, and their strength is equivalent to the foundation building stage of cultivation.

He has mastered the ability to burn cities and destroy countries, and to fly imperial weapons. In the eyes of mortals, he is no different from a fairy.

Now that he has such a huge power in his hands, Zhong Yu can't help being complacent and ambitious. For the world that will be faced next, the pressure and tension in my heart can not help but dissipate a lot.

After all, Zhong Yu still has several sets of formations in his hand, which are specially provided for the evolution of the army. When these soldiers are deployed, they can completely kill the enemy several steps higher.

If the power of the entire imperial kingdom is gathered, even if it is a demigod whose strength is as high as the seventh rank and has already ignited life, or a great monk in the Nascent Soul stage, I am afraid that his halberd will be smashed and his life will be saved.

"The preparations are complete, and now it's time to look for the next world! I had a premonition before that it should be a world of immortals, with people above the sixth level of immortal gods. If I can understand and control it, it should be able to free me from this curse Let's go!" Taking a long breath and calming down, Zhong Yu's eyes were filled with anticipation for the world he was about to enter.

He had a premonition before that his next world should not be low-level, and it should also be the world of the Eastern Immortals. Although it is not clear which one it is, there are always immortals.

This is not simple, a world where immortals exist, even in the heavens and worlds, is extremely rare.

Of course, this kind of rarity is compared to those countless ordinary worlds, and compared to other worlds of immortals and gods, it is just a drop in the ocean.

In addition, Zhong Yu also found dozens of ordinary worlds through his own small world.

Some of them don't have any extraordinary power at all, and some of them are just some low-martial and low-magic worlds equivalent to Jin Yong's martial arts, which are far inferior to Qin Shimingyue.

Since the level of these worlds is far lower than the small world controlled by Zhong Yu, it is possible to directly investigate the news of these worlds and obtain specific information about the world.

With this information, Zhong Yu assigned all the soldiers, generals and civil and military ministers below the third rank in his empire, and ordered them to go to these worlds to attack.

Although the strength of these people is not very good in Zhong Yu's eyes, but for those low-level worlds, they are as unstoppable as immortals.

With these strengths, it is not difficult to conquer these small worlds.

And after the strategy was completed, Zhong Yu didn't have any intention of recalling them, but let them become the gods of that world on the spot.

Let them help themselves adjust the yin and yang of the world, that is, plunder the luck of that world, and keep transporting it to their own small world.

Under the magic of the law of casting the holy court, it is completely possible to make these ministers become the gods of that world. Replacing the position of Tiandao, possessing mysterious power and power.

With the authority of heaven, it is not difficult for these ministers to search for some luck and transport it back to their own small world.

And as the masters of the heavenly court, these gods also injected their true spirits into the list of gods and were controlled by themselves. In addition, their core authority was also tampered with by Zhong Yu, who took control of the core.

With these two precautions, Zhong Yudao is not afraid of their resistance or withholding luck without permission.

And Zhong Yu also made a hierarchical differentiation of these worlds, as well as the class distinction of gods.

The world without any extraordinary power in it was classified as a first-class world by Zhong Yu. This kind of world is assigned by the empire to rule the gods, called the gods. Under the blessing of the power of the world, these gods can probably reach the fifth level of cultivation.

And the world that has extraordinary power, but has not reached the first level of gods, is divided into the second level world. The gods assigned to rule this level of world are called Xingjun. The world is under the blessing of world power, depending on the level of world power. Able to break through the immortal barrier and reach the sixth or seventh order, that is, the cultivation base of the Jindan stage and the Nascent Soul stage.

Then there is a world where there are demigods or Jindan Nascent Souls, but there is no real god or sanctification, which is divided into a third-level world. The gods assigned to rule these worlds are called Tianjun. Under the blessing of the power of the world, Tianjun can directly break through the realm of true gods or immortals, and achieve immortality in the true sense.

And the gods under the blessing of these worlds, whether they are gods, stars, or heavens, as long as the world they canonize is not destroyed, then they will never die.

Even if someone beats her to death, she will slowly recover in that world with the help of the miraculous effect of the Conferred God List and the blessing of heaven.

This is another kind of immortality.
